prompt: How long does a free Postgres database last on Render?

result.text:
A free PostgreSQL database on Render lasts for 30 days from the date it is created.

Key details regarding the lifespan and limits of a free Render database include:

The Expiration Clock: Once 30 days are up, the database expires and becomes inaccessible.

The Grace Period: After expiration, you have a 14-day grace period to upgrade your database to a paid plan (starting at $6/month) to save your data.

Deletion: If you do not upgrade before the grace period ends, Render permanently deletes the database and all of its contents.

Other Limitations: Free databases are restricted to 1 GB of storage, allow up to 100 connections, and do not support automated backups.

If you are just using it for a quick test, prototype, or tutorial, you can spin up a new one after expiration, but anything intended for long-term use will need to be migrated or upgraded before the 30-day mark.

A free PostgreSQL database on Render lasts for **30 days** from the date it is created. [Deploy for Free – Render Docs](https://render.com/docs/free#:~:text=For%20long%2Dterm%20data%20storage%3A%20*%20Paid%20services,Postgres%20databases%20expire%2030%20days%20after%20creation.)

Key details regarding the lifespan and limits of a free Render database include:

  * **The Expiration Clock:** Once 30 days are up, the database expires and becomes inaccessible.

  * **The Grace Period:** After expiration, you have a **14-day grace period** to upgrade your database to a paid plan (starting at $6/month) to save your data.

  * **Deletion:** If you do not upgrade before the grace period ends, Render permanently deletes the database and all of its contents.

  * **Other Limitations:** Free databases are restricted to **1 GB of storage**, allow up to 100 connections, and do not support automated backups.

If you are just using it for a quick test, prototype, or tutorial, you can spin up a new one after expiration, but anything intended for long-term use will need to be migrated or upgraded before the 30-day mark.
